scope: Use the fourteen review requirements when preparing/binding the actual-operation recorder and public-only independent audit. Final published producer, source/runtime/gates/phase pin identities remain unbound; no actual invocation or gate acceptance occurs now.
returned_report_evidence: Under the reviewed CLI, stdout is serialization of the inspect return after final close; it is not a separately measured third channel. Require exact canonical stdout/persisted agreement plus accepted exit, cleanup and before/after state. Never repeat an operation to manufacture return evidence.
stopping: At most two slots per phase. No automatic dependent phase or second invocation after mechanical/guard failure, ambiguous output, timeout, cleanup failure or source drift. Preserve the failure and stop that operation route. An already frozen identical second run can reproduce a completed negative C without revising its binding.
scientific_boundary: Exit0 engineering completeness never implies scientific admission, true physical values, fresh evaluation or semantic readiness. G20/G21 gates remain separate.
